selection_basis: Raw and hybrid handoffs both preserve counsel-first sequencing with an intake check for channel bias.
what_it_might_reveal: Counsel selection is part of the safety sequence because different attorneys may lean toward different reporting channels.
source_grounding: The raw handoff warns that counsel-first should include questions about internal-first, audit-committee-first, and external-first choices.
cheap_test_for_step6: Check whether the answer tells the user to contact counsel while also asking how counsel decides among reporting channels.
hard_boundary: Do not replace counsel with self-directed reporting or make channel choice before legal review.
relaxation_condition: Relax only if the answer avoids reporting-channel choice entirely.
discard_condition: Discard only if counsel selection and reporting channel are absent from the answer.
risk_if_forced: The answer may make the user distrust counsel and act alone.
risk_if_ignored: The user may outsource judgment to an advisor whose incentives are unexamined.
